text:
Maya (product): Heads-up — BeaconCorp wants tenant-level KMS + per-tenant quota for their private pilot. They require HSM-backed keys eventually, SLA 99.95, and burst slots. Can we prioritize?
Jordan (eng-runtime): For runtime we need routing + cache isolation + model variant pinning. KMS is @Liam. Quota/burst touches infra. If we scope to an MVP (cloud KMS + soft quota) I think ~4 weeks.
Tara (eng-infra): We can add tenant quota tokens + a burst pool, but allocator changes + metric shard migration required. My rough estimate is 2-3 sprints for a safe rollout.
Liam (eng-security): HSM per-tenant is heavy: key provisioning, attestation, rotation, and audit logs. A staged approach makes sense — customer-supplied cloud KMS first, HSM later.
Maya (product): BeaconCorp insists on HSM in contract language. Is staged acceptable? We need a clear timeline we can share.
Liam (eng-security): Staged plan: 1) customer-managed cloud KMS with dedicated key + audit (P0 for pilot) — ~2w. 2) HSM-backed key material (partner/on-prem) — ~8-12w depending on partner and legal. I'll draft details.
Jordan (eng-runtime): Runtime asks: policy to route tenant -> dedicated pool, fallback rules, and KV cache isolation. That requires a feature flag + rollout plan. Also need to support fallback to hosted model variant with degraded SLO.
Oz (product-ops): Proposed acceptance criteria for pilot: (a) tenant traffic pinning to dedicated pool, (b) KMS-based key on customer side + rotation + audit logs, (c) quota enforcement with metrics and alerts, (d) documented fail-open/fail-closed behaviour and rollback playbook.
Tara (eng-infra): Note risk: strict quota enforcement in allocator could cause head-of-line blocking for other tenants. Suggest implementing a rate-limiter + soft-threshold alerts first, then tighten to hard-enforce after canary.
Maya (product): Can we scope an MVP: customer cloud KMS (no HSM), token-based quota + small burst pool, isolated cache, and 5% canary? If yes, propose we aim for ~6 weeks pilot.
Liam (eng-security): I can own the threat model + runbook for the MVP. Will produce a short runbook and audit checklist in 2w.
Jordan (eng-runtime): I'll prototype the routing flag and cache isolation in a branch. Need infra to expose pool IDs and a simple API to pin traffic. Target: 3w for prototype.
Tara (eng-infra): I'll start the allocator changes and a migration plan for metric shards. Expect a PR + test plan in ~3w. Need 2-3 reviewers from eng-sre and eng-runtime.
Maya (product): Action items: 1) Liam: threat model/runbook (due +2w), 2) Jordan: routing & cache prototype (+3w), 3) Tara: quota allocator PR (+3w), 4) Oz: acceptance test matrix & customer-facing timeline. I'll update BeaconCorp with staged HSM dates and ask them to sign the pilot addendum. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary env created: beaconcorp-pilot-1 (namespace: prod-canary-17)
Maya (product): Quick config snippet for the flag we discussed:
```
# feature flag + simple routing
FLAG_BEACON_PILOT=true
route_policy:
  tenant_pin: beaconcorp
  pool: dedicated-beacon-1
  fallback: hosted-compatible-quant
```
Jordan (eng-runtime): One more note — we should document SLO degradations in the rollout docs (latency and token-cost expectations). I'll add a section in the runtime checklist.
Tara (eng-infra): I'll schedule a short design review with eng-sre and eng-runtime next Tue.
Maya (product): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the pilot scope. I'll send a recap and assign JIRA tickets after the design review.
